thread.title: UPDATE: U.S. stocks close 1% higher as tech rallies

author: morningstar.com
title: UPDATE: U.S. stocks close 1% higher as tech rallies
text:
U.S. stocks closed sharply higher on Monday, with both the Dow and the S&P 500 extending their winning streak to a third straight session as concerns over inflation continued to ease on Wall Street. The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 398 points, or 1.6%, to 25,708. The S&P 500 jumped 1.2%, or 32 points, to 2,780. The Nasdaq Composite Index added 84 points, or 1.2%, to 7,421. All three are within 4% of record levels hit last month. The day's gains were broad, with 10 of the 11 primary S&P 500 sectors up on the day. Tech was one of the primary gainers, up 1.6% as Apple Inc. (AAPL) rallied 2% and Intel Corp. (INTC) closed up 2.9%. Recent gains have come on waning fears that inflation was returning to markets, and that the Federal Reserve would have to become more aggressive in raising interest rates to combat such a scenario. The worries about inflation pushed the Dow and S&P into correction territory earlier this month. On the Fed front, the main attraction this week will be Fed Chairman Powell, who will head to Capitol Hill on Tuesday for the first of two sessions of questions with U.S. lawmakers. Among other insights, investors want to know if the Fed is planning four interest-rate hikes for 2018 instead of three.
-Ryan Vlastelica; 1603ET
